performance.method: Cold-fetch via curl --max-time 30 (one-shot per URL, no warm-up). Warm-CDN times measured by re-curling the same URLs immediately after. Browser-side metrics from performance.timing on Manali reload.

seo_meta.canonical_present: true on all 11 real destinations + /en/collections + collection slugs; absent on /en/destination/spiti and /hi/destination/spiti (because those serve homepage HTML).

regression_matrix.title: Invisible content rendering on all destination detail pages
regression_matrix.evidence: All 11 real destinations rendered visible content with 24-38 H2s, 26-61 H3s, 6-14 H4s, 6 JSON-LD blocks each, 6-15 'confidence' mentions. No invisible-content artifacts in /en or /hi.

regression_matrix.title: Only 1 of 20 collections rendering
regression_matrix.evidence: /en/collections lists 91 collection links; /hi/collections also 91. Sample of 5 real slugs (best-beaches-india, adrenaline-rush, after-dark-experiences, ancient-monasteries, andaman-diving-snorkeling) all return 200 in both locales with proper bodies.

regression_matrix.title: 503 Service Unavailable on RSC prefetch
regression_matrix.evidence: RSC: 1 header on /en/destination/jaipur returns 200 with content-type text/x-component (199KB body). No 503s on RSC paths.

regression_matrix.title: Empty modal flash between wizard steps
regression_matrix.evidence: /en/plan is a single-form AI matcher (43 buttons, 1 input, 0 modals, 0 'data-step' wizard markers). No multi-step wizard exists today, so the flash defect cannot recur in the original surface area.

regression_matrix.title: Hindi translation only partially applied
regression_matrix.evidence: Destination titles localize the city name to Devanagari (e.g. जयपुर) but state name and the suffix 'Best Time to Visit & Weather | NakshIQ' remain English on every /hi destination. Hindi collection page titles (5/5 sampled) are entirely English. Same partial-translation surface as 2026-04-27.

regression_matrix.title: Duration field shows '- days' (missing data)
regression_matrix.evidence: No '- days' string in any sampled destination HTML; itinerary endpoint returns structured 4xx errors (not malformed days field).

regression_matrix.title: Map markers vs results count mismatch
regression_matrix.evidence: On /en/destination/jaipur the page body claims '20 Places' but document.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-marker-icon').length === 0 after 8s. Same on /en/destination/leh ('20' vs 0) and /en/destination/manali ('23 Places' vs 0). Leaflet container, panes (7), and basemap tiles all render — only the marker pane is empty. Third consecutive day of reproduction.

regression_matrix.title: Duplicate 'NakshIQ' in destination page titles
regression_matrix.evidence: All 24 sampled destination titles contain exactly one 'NakshIQ' token.

regression_matrix.title: Treks page title contradicts body content count
regression_matrix.evidence: /en/treks 200, 1.16MB body, no obvious title-vs-count contradiction. Heuristic curl + grep didn't expose a mismatch and no regression evidence collected since 2026-04-25.

regression_matrix.title: Filter bar disappears after Clear Filters
regression_matrix.evidence: On /en/explore: clicked '👶 Kids Friendly' chip (button count 122→124), then clicked 'Clear Filters ✕' (button count remained 124, filter bar still visible, Kids Friendly chip still present). No collapse.

regression_matrix.title: 930 network requests on single page load
regression_matrix.evidence: Fresh load of /en/destination/leh issued ~57 network requests (29 first-party JS/CSS chunks, 14 basemap tiles, 4 fonts, 2 API calls, plus analytics). Repeat load of /en/destination/jaipur ~54 requests. Far below the 930 observed on 2026-04-22.

regression_matrix.title: Multiple GoTrueClient instances warning (Supabase)
regression_matrix.evidence: Console captured during /en/destination/jaipur and /en/destination/manali navigations contained no GoTrueClient/Multiple/Supabase warnings (only an unrelated chrome-extension log line).

regression_matrix.title: Heading hierarchy skips H2 entirely
regression_matrix.evidence: All 11 real destinations have 24-38 H2s; H2 hierarchy intact. Spiti soft-404 has 0 H2s but that is a separate defect (see BUG-007 cluster and NEW-2026-04-28-002).

regression_matrix.title: Card images slow to load (lazy loading too aggressive)
regression_matrix.evidence: On /en/destination/jaipur counted 31 : 15 loading=lazy, 0 loading=eager, 16 with no loading attribute. Lazy:eager ratio still skewed lazy. Cannot programmatically measure perceived speed without LCP samples; flagged as partial-unverifiable to track the underlying ratio without claiming a UX regression.

new_defects.title: /sitemap.xml top-level regressed from 404 to 500 in 24h
new_defects.evidence: GET https://www.nakshiq.com/sitemap.xml returned HTTP 500 in 2.44s with a 10,560-byte body. Yesterday's run reported HTTP 404 on the same path. Server error responses are worse than 404s for crawlers (Google may de-rank) and indicate an unhandled exception in the sitemap-index handler.
new_defects.impact: SEO crawlers that probe /sitemap.xml first (default behavior for many bots) will hit a 500 instead of a clean 404 + robots.txt redirect. May degrade index coverage.

new_defects.title: hreflang link tags STILL absent site-wide (3rd consecutive day)
new_defects.evidence: Counted 0 <link rel="alternate" hreflang> tags on /en/destination/jaipur, /hi/destination/jaipur, /en/destination/leh, /en/collections, /en, /hi. First flagged 2026-04-26 as NEW-001, repeated 2026-04-27 as NEW-005. No fix shipped.
new_defects.impact: Bilingual SEO is leaving Hindi-page indexability on the table — Google has no signal that /en/destination/jaipur and /hi/destination/jaipur are alternates, so it may de-duplicate them.

new_defects.title: Soft-404 on /destination/<bad-slug> persists in BOTH locales
new_defects.evidence: /en/destination/this-does-not-exist-xyz → 200, 72,949 bytes; /hi/destination/this-does-not-exist-xyz → 200, 83,667 bytes. Both serve homepage shell. /en/collections/<bad>, /en/region/<bad>, and other top-level paths now correctly return 404 — soft-404 is now isolated to the destination route group.
new_defects.impact: Crawlers can index unbounded fake URLs; analytics gets dirtied. Narrower scope than yesterday's NEW-004 (collection/region paths fixed) but the destination route is the largest section of the site.
new_defects.recommended_owner: web (apps/web/src/app/[locale]/destination/[slug]/page.tsx — call notFound() on missing row)
new_defects.likely_regression_of: Carryover of 2026-04-27 NEW-004 (now scoped to /destination only)

new_defects.title: Numeric month sub-routes /destination/<slug>/<1-12> still soft-404 (llms.txt contract violation)
new_defects.evidence: Probed /en/destination/jaipur/3, /5, /10 and /en/destination/shimla/3, /5, /10 — all returned 200 with 73,304-73,306 bytes (homepage shell). The named variants (/march, /may, /october) return 147-175KB real pages. llms.txt promises numeric month routes; they are not honored. Carryover of 2026-04-27 NEW-007.
new_defects.impact: AI crawlers following llms.txt advice get indexed onto homepage HTML for what they think are month-specific destination pages — bad for citation quality and llms.txt audits.

new_defects.title: /en/region/<state> 404s for tamil-nadu AND kerala (grew from 1 to 2 missing region pages)
new_defects.evidence: Probed 7 region landing pages. 200: rajasthan, karnataka, maharashtra, ladakh, himachal-pradesh. 404: tamil-nadu (carryover from 2026-04-27 NEW-003), kerala (NEW today). Both states have many destinations in the sitemap — the region landing simply doesn't exist.
new_defects.impact: Two large source-of-traffic states have no region-level landing page; users navigating from sitemap or external links land on a 404.

new_defects.title: /en/cost-index payload still 3.61 MB (no shrink in 48h)
new_defects.evidence: GET /en/cost-index returned 200 in 1.73s with 3,612,641 bytes. Identical size to 2026-04-27 (3.6 MB) and 2026-04-26. No shrink shipped.
new_defects.impact: Slow load on mobile connections; ~15s on a 2 Mbps link. Likely contains a large embedded data payload that should be paginated or fetched async.

new_defects.title: Cold-fetch tail (binsar, darjeeling) still > 3s
new_defects.evidence: Cold curl times: hi/darjeeling 4.255s, hi/binsar 3.980s, en/darjeeling 3.542s, en/binsar 3.174s. p95 across 24 cold fetches = 3.98s, max = 4.26s. Avg = 1.53s. None exceed the 8s 'cold-start critical' threshold from the QA skill but the long tail has not improved since 2026-04-27.
new_defects.impact: Real-user p95 likely above the 2.5s LCP target on these specific destinations; first-visit experience degraded.
new_defects.recommended_owner: web (per-destination SSR cost; possibly Supabase query plan for these slugs)
new_defects.reproduction: for s in darjeeling binsar; do for l in en hi; do curl -o /dev/null -w "$l/$s: %{time_total}s\n" https://www.nakshiq.com/$l/destination/$s; done; done

new_defects.title: Confidence mention count drops 18-25% in /hi vs /en (proxy for partial-Hindi)
new_defects.evidence: Per-page count of the literal token 'confidence' in HTML: en/jaipur 11 vs hi/jaipur 9; en/shimla 12 vs hi/shimla 10; en/manali 15 vs hi/manali 13; en/leh 13 vs hi/leh 11. Pattern repeats across all 11 real destinations: Hindi pages have ~2 fewer 'confidence' tokens. The token should be a localized synonym in /hi but is currently still English in some sub-blocks while absent in others.
new_defects.impact: Adds another data point under BUG-005 — Hindi shipping rate is partial. Not a new bug class but quantifies the gap.
new_defects.reproduction: for s in jaipur shimla manali leh; do echo $s; for l in en hi; do curl -s https://www.nakshiq.com/$l/destination/$s | grep -oiE confidence | wc -l; done; done

gaps: Live console message capture is partial — Chrome MCP starts tracking only after the first read_console_messages call; messages emitted during the initial page load are not retrievable. BUG-012 verdict relies on a navigation-then-read pattern (no GoTrueClient warnings observed) but a deterministic hard-reload-with-pre-subscribed-console would be stronger.

Browser-side performance metrics sampled on a single page (Manali reload) — primary perf signal is curl time_total, which conflates DNS+TLS+TTFB+download. Real-user TTFB / LCP / INP would require a full Web Vitals run.
/api/itinerary POST request schema is undocumented — validated only that empty payload returns structured 4xx and a likely-shaped payload returns 4xx. A green-path 200 response is not exercised.
